title: TIDE: Asymmetric Neural Circuits for Stabilized Temporal Inhibitory-Excitatory Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2605.19403v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) architecture decouples internal computation from external inputs via neural dynamics, but relies on unconstrained multi-layer perceptrons for its recurrent computations. We propose to model neural dynamics using asymmetric Excitatory-Inhibitory (E-I) networks, which can be stabilized via principles from network theory, while obeying Dale's principle and can be expressed as energy-based systems optimized through a game-theoretic loss. Building on this perspective, we introduce Temporal Inhibitory-Excitatory Dynamic Engine (TIDE), a neuro-inspired architecture that computes internal representations through neural dynamics stabilized by incorporating the Wilson-Cowan dynamics and lateral inhibition. translated_title: TIDE：用于稳定时序抑制-兴奋动力学的非对称神经回路
translated_abstract: 近期的连续思维机器（CTM）架构通过神经动力学将内部计算与外部输入解耦，但其循环计算依赖于无约束的多层感知机。我们提出使用非对称的兴奋-抑制（E-I）网络来建模神经动力学，该网络可以借助网络理论原理实现稳定，同时遵循Dale原则，并可表示为通过博弈论损失优化的能量系统。基于这一视角，我们提出了时序抑制-兴奋动力学引擎，这是一种神经启发架构，通过引入Wilson-Cowan动力学和侧向抑制来稳定神经动力学，从而计算内部表示。TIDE在多个方面兼顾了生物真实性，例如使用分层感受野，并强制执行Dale原则以确保符合生物学现实的80:20兴奋-抑制平衡比例，同时保持端到端可训练的架构。
tldr: 提出了神经启发架构TIDE，它通过遵循Dale原则的非对称兴奋-抑制回路，结合Wilson-Cowan动力学与侧向抑制来稳定神经动力学，从而改进了连续思维机器的内部计算方式。
en_tdlr: TIDE is a neuro-inspired architecture that stabilizes neural dynamics through asymmetric excitatory-inhibitory circuits obeying Dale's principle, incorporating Wilson-Cowan dynamics and lateral inhibition to improve the internal computation of Continuous Thought Machines.
